message:
docs(history): four suites went red, and the session state moved with them

Recorded as an observation, not a verdict. The verifier established our changes
cannot reach three of them (no link at all for two; the third links
directory_client.cpp but touches neither HostAgent nor any new function). That
says "not by this path" -- it does not on its own prove unrelated, and the entry
keeps that distinction.

What I found on re-running them: all four fail by producing NOTHING from the
desktop. host_bgra_scale fails at "desktop thumbnail captured";
gdi_capture_process reports GDI_DELIVERED_FRAMES=0; host_encode_epoch fails in
the D3D11 NV12 hardware MFT path. Meanwhile udp_control_e2e, which has no such
dependency, went from 1P/17F to 16P/2F -- it improved.

And qwinsta is not what it was when the sweep was green: session 1 (the one the
tests run in) is now Disc, and the console has no user attached. A disconnected
session has no desktop to capture.

That is a strong candidate and it is written down as a candidate. The project rule
about RDP exists for this reason, and its consequence applies here too: results
produced in the wrong session state are not evidence either way. A clean verdict
needs the same binaries re-run with the console attached.

The two sweep totals also differ -- 1780 theirs, 1762 mine. Decomposed rather than
argued: udp_control_e2e's improvement accounts for +15, and the remaining +3 is
recorded as unexplained rather than waved through.
